name: Cinnamon Apple Ring Pastries
desc: Granny Smith apple rings wrapped in puff pastry strips, baked in cinnamon sugar and drizzled with caramel.

source.title: Cinnamon Apple Ring Pastries
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1 (17.3 oz) package frozen puff pastry (2 sheets), thawed

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment. Thaw the puff pastry according to the package.
Core the apples with an apple corer or small round cookie cutter and slice them into 1/2 in rings.
Roll the pastry with a rolling pin to stretch it longer and thinner. Cut long 1/2 in strips with a pizza cutter.
Gently pull each strip thinner and wrap it around an apple ring, pinching strips together end to end as needed.
Mix the sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl.
Set the wrapped rings on the sheet, brush with melted butter, and sprinkle generously with cinnamon sugar.
Bake on the middle rack 15-18 min, until the pastry is golden brown.
Cool 3-5 min, drizzle with caramel, and serve with ice cream.
tips: Thawed pie crust works in place of puff pastry.
If you skip the caramel, sprinkle on more cinnamon sugar so they are sweet enough.

references.title: Cinnamon Apple Pastries
